metadata.title: Trastuzumab Emtansine (T-DM1) Therapy – 21 days
metadata.indication: Previously treated HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.source_version_verification_method: manual comparison with current official NCCP PDF header and version-control information
metadata.legacy_internal_id_note: Stable internal ID retained to avoid breaking existing bookmarks and catalogue references; display metadata now records the explicit NCCP source version.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: NCCP bilirubin Table 5 leaves >10–20 ×ULN unassigned; EMA SmPC says discontinue above 10. Encoded hold plus urgent source reconciliation, not silent normality.
Independent clinical and pharmacy review pending.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded contraindication or hold criterion was triggered. Complete normal prescribing and pharmacy checks.

rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate supplied values independently. Missing values remain unassessed; never infer normality or phase.

action.recommendation: Relevant drug / excipient allergy: do not administer. SC trastuzumab also contains hyaluronidase.

rules.explanation: Relevant drug / excipient allergy: do not administer. SC trastuzumab also contains hyaluronidase.

action.recommendation: Do not proceed without urgent oncology / obstetric risk-benefit review. Pregnancy is not labelled an absolute SmPC contraindication; fetal harm is possible.

rules.explanation: Do not proceed without urgent oncology / obstetric risk-benefit review. Pregnancy is not labelled an absolute SmPC contraindication; fetal harm is possible.

action.recommendation: Breastfeeding must be stopped during treatment and for 7 months after the final dose; discuss the individual plan before treatment.

rules.explanation: Breastfeeding must be stopped during treatment and for 7 months after the final dose; discuss the individual plan before treatment.

action.recommendation: Outside the NCCP performance-status population: consultant review required.

rules.explanation: Outside the NCCP performance-status population: consultant review required.

action.recommendation: The source requires validated HER2-positive disease. Reconcile tumour testing before selecting this regimen.

rules.explanation: The source requires validated HER2-positive disease. Reconcile tumour testing before selecting this regimen.

action.recommendation: The full source indication / prior treatment criteria have not been confirmed. Review the regimen choice.

rules.explanation: The full source indication / prior treatment criteria have not been confirmed. Review the regimen choice.

action.recommendation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer without specialist reassessment of the treatment plan.

rules.explanation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer without specialist reassessment of the treatment plan.

action.recommendation: Required cardiac monitoring is unavailable. Arrange the result and documented consultant decision before the next administration; do not assume normal function.

rules.explanation: Required cardiac monitoring is unavailable. Arrange the result and documented consultant decision before the next administration; do not assume normal function.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity: discontinue and manage the reaction urgently.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity: discontinue and manage the reaction urgently.

action.recommendation: Baseline LVEF must be ≥50% in the NCCP inclusion criteria. Obtain specialist review before initiation.

rules.explanation: Baseline LVEF must be ≥50% in the NCCP inclusion criteria. Obtain specialist review before initiation.

action.recommendation: Hold until platelets ≥75, then reduce one dose level. Restart requires review of the actual current dose and all other toxicities.

rules.explanation: Hold until platelets ≥75, then reduce one dose level. Restart requires review of the actual current dose and all other toxicities.

action.recommendation: Hold until platelets ≥75, then resume at the same dose level. Restart requires review of the actual current dose and all other toxicities.

rules.explanation: Hold until platelets ≥75, then resume at the same dose level. Restart requires review of the actual current dose and all other toxicities.

action.recommendation: A prior platelet hold has not recovered to ≥75. Continue holding; do not treat 50–74 as recovery. Restart requires review of the actual current dose and all other toxicities.

rules.explanation: A prior platelet hold has not recovered to ≥75. Continue holding; do not treat 50–74 as recovery. Restart requires review of the actual current dose and all other toxicities.

action.recommendation: Hold for transaminases >5–20 ×ULN until grade ≤2, then reduce one dose level. Grade 2 alone does not trigger the metastatic table hold.

rules.explanation: Hold for transaminases >5–20 ×ULN until grade ≤2, then reduce one dose level. Grade 2 alone does not trigger the metastatic table hold.

action.recommendation: Transaminases >20 ×ULN: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Transaminases >20 ×ULN: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Hold for transaminases >5–20 ×ULN until grade ≤2, then reduce one dose level. Grade 2 alone does not trigger the metastatic table hold.

rules.explanation: Hold for transaminases >5–20 ×ULN until grade ≤2, then reduce one dose level. Grade 2 alone does not trigger the metastatic table hold.

action.recommendation: Transaminases >20 ×ULN: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Transaminases >20 ×ULN: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Hold bilirubin until grade ≤1, then consider same dose level after clinical review.

rules.explanation: Hold bilirubin until grade ≤1, then consider same dose level after clinical review.

action.recommendation: Hold bilirubin until grade ≤1, then consider one lower dose level after clinical review.

rules.explanation: Hold bilirubin until grade ≤1, then consider one lower dose level after clinical review.

action.recommendation: SOURCE DISCREPANCY: NCCP Table 5 prints grade 4 >20 ×ULN, leaving 10–20 unassigned; current EMA SmPC defines grade 4 >10 and says discontinue. Do not administer; urgent consultant/pharmacy reconciliation with the SmPC is required.

rules.explanation: SOURCE DISCREPANCY: NCCP Table 5 prints grade 4 >20 ×ULN, leaving 10–20 unassigned; current EMA SmPC defines grade 4 >10 and says discontinue. Do not administer; urgent consultant/pharmacy reconciliation with the SmPC is required.

action.recommendation: Bilirubin >20 ×ULN: discontinue under both the printed NCCP band and the current EMA SmPC.

rules.explanation: Bilirubin >20 ×ULN: discontinue under both the printed NCCP band and the current EMA SmPC.

action.recommendation: Transaminases >3 and bilirubin >2 ×ULN without another likely cause: permanently discontinue.

rules.explanation: Transaminases >3 and bilirubin >2 ×ULN without another likely cause: permanently discontinue.

action.recommendation: Combined hepatic thresholds require urgent causal assessment. If no other likely cause, permanently discontinue; do not assume an alternative cause.

rules.explanation: Combined hepatic thresholds require urgent causal assessment. If no other likely cause, permanently discontinue; do not assume an alternative cause.

action.recommendation: Hold and repeat LVEF within 3 weeks; discontinue if below 40% is confirmed.

rules.explanation: Hold and repeat LVEF within 3 weeks; discontinue if below 40% is confirmed.

action.recommendation: Hold and repeat LVEF within 3 weeks. If not recovered to within 10 points of baseline, discontinue.

rules.explanation: Hold and repeat LVEF within 3 weeks. If not recovered to within 10 points of baseline, discontinue.

action.recommendation: Metastatic table permits continuation with repeat LVEF within 3 weeks; review all other risks. This differs from early-breast T-DM1.

rules.explanation: Metastatic table permits continuation with repeat LVEF within 3 weeks; review all other risks. This differs from early-breast T-DM1.

action.recommendation: The baseline LVEF change is required in the metastatic 40–45% branch. Do not infer a small fall.

rules.explanation: The baseline LVEF change is required in the metastatic 40–45% branch. Do not infer a small fall.

action.recommendation: Symptomatic CHF: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Symptomatic CHF: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Persistent LVEF below 40% on the required repeat: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Persistent LVEF below 40% on the required repeat: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Failure to recover after the 40–45% / ≥10-point decline hold: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Failure to recover after the 40–45% / ≥10-point decline hold: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Diagnosed ILD / pneumonitis, any grade: permanently discontinue.

rules.explanation: Diagnosed ILD / pneumonitis, any grade: permanently discontinue.

action.recommendation: Confirmed NRH: permanently discontinue.

rules.explanation: Confirmed NRH: permanently discontinue.

action.recommendation: Hold neuropathy until grade ≤2. A reduction may be considered at retreatment after review.

rules.explanation: Hold neuropathy until grade ≤2. A reduction may be considered at retreatment after review.

action.recommendation: Further reduction below 2.4 mg/kg: discontinue. Never re-escalate after a dose reduction.

rules.explanation: Further reduction below 2.4 mg/kg: discontinue. Never re-escalate after a dose reduction.

action.recommendation: Severe organ impairment has insufficient dosing data. Obtain specialist review and close monitoring; do not invent a percentage reduction.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
summary: Use the local low-emetogenic supportive medicines pathway.
Monitor platelets, liver function, neuropathy and cardiac function before treatment as applicable.
supportive_care.provenance: National NCCP antiemetic guidance is linked for antiemetic support. Confirm regimen specific supportive care against the current NCCP protocol and applicable local policy.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest active parenteral component is low emetogenic risk in NCCP V6 Table 7.

treatment_phases.name: Metastatic T-DM1 until progression / unacceptable toxicity

administration.notes: Not the 14-cycle early-breast course. Subsequent levels 3 and 2.4 mg/kg; never re-escalate.
